title: Make Ahead Caesar Dressing
ingredients: 3 tablespoons (50 mL) extra virgin olive oil
2 teaspoons (10 mL) anchovy paste, or to taste
fresh cracked black pepper to taste (be generous)
directions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and whisk well to combine. Store in a tight-sealed jar in the fridge until needed.
notes: Preparation time: 10 minutes; Cook time: None

This dressing, if kept in a tight-sealed jar in the fridge, will keep up to two weeks and offers a quick way to dress a Caesar salad. It also makes a great dip for raw vegetables or a spread for a grilled chicken breast sandwich.
raw_text:
Make Ahead Caesar Dressing
Makes: 1 1/2 cups (375 mL)
This dressing, if kept in a tight-sealed jar in the fridge, will keep up to two weeks and offers a quick way to dress a Caesar salad. It also makes a great dip for raw vegetables or a spread for a grilled chicken breast sandwich.
Preparation time: 10 minutes
Cook time: None
2 garlic cloves, crushed
2 teaspoons (10 mL) Dijon mustard
1/2 teaspoon (2 mL) sugar
1 cup (250 mL) mayonnaise
3 tablespoons (50 mL) extra virgin olive oil
2 teaspoons (10 mL) anchovy paste, or to taste
1 tablespoon (15 mL) red wine vinegar
2 tablespoons (25 mL) lemon juice
2 tablespoons (25 mL) water
1 teaspoon (5 mL) Worcestershire sauce
1/2 teaspoon (2 mL) Tabasco sauce
fresh cracked black pepper to taste (be generous)
Place all ingredients in a bowl and whisk well to combine. Store in a tight-sealed jar in the fridge until needed.
Victoria Times Colonist

title: Colorful Rotini Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups rotini pasta cooked in salted boiling water. Drain; run under cold water and cool.
Vegetables - Use any or all. Dice small or large. English cucumber, seeded tomatoes, celery, carrots, small broccoli flowers and peeled stems, green onions, zucchini, and small peas.
If too thick, thin with a little vinegar
directions: 1. Beat together well and pour over pasta and veggies. Let stand for several hours before serving. Will hold up in fridge for several days.
2. Or use Ranch Dressing to which you have added 2 Tablespoons lemon juice with lemon and herb seasoning to taste.
notes: Handwritten at top: From Mary Ann - good
Printed intro: I love this twisted pasta because each little twist holds a taste of the dressing. I use white with a little green bought in bulk bins. I like this better than the many colors.
( I found different brands of dressing gave me different results but they were all good)
Check mark in margin beside dressing

title: Broccoli Mandarin Salad
ingredients: 10 oz. can mandarin oranges, drained (284 mL)
directions: To make dressing: In a saucepan, whisk together eggs, sugar, cornstarch and dry mustard. Add vinegar and water and cook slowly until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in mayonnaise. Cool.
To make salad: Marinate broccoli in dressing for several hours. Add remaining ingredients and toss well. Serves 6. (See picture - page 53.)
notes: Printed page torn from a spiral-bound cookbook

BROCCOLI MANDARIN SALAD
EVEN GEORGE WILL LIKE THIS!
DRESSING
2 EGGS
1/2 CUP SUGAR  125 mL

SALAD
